name: DRV8874_Q1
description: TI DRV8874-Q1 automotive (AEC-Q100) integrated N-channel H-bridge brushed-DC motor driver: 4.5-37 V VM, 6 A peak, 100 mOhm typ per FET, charge pump for 100 % duty, IPROPI current-mirror output (450 uA/A) with VREF/ITRIP current regulation, PH/EN or PWM or independent half-bridge control (PMODE strap), IMODE strap selecting retry vs latched-off OCP and nFAULT reporting of chopping, UVLO/CPUV/OCP/TSD. Tier-1 brushed bridge of docs/OpenSecureESC-Brushed-Specifications.md; first instance builds/6s/10A/BRUSHED_CAN_485_isolation/ (Serenity-UAV nacelle-tilt gearmotor, 2.9 A stall). The non-automotive DRV8874 [62] is pin-identical in the same package.
verification: VERIFIED -- full 16-pin map read directly from the local copy of [63] (TI SLVSF67B, 'Revised January 2021'), Sec. 5 'Pin Configuration and Functions', Figure 5-1 'DRV8874-Q1 PWP Package 16-Pin HTSSOP With Exposed Thermal Pad Top View' and the Pin Functions table, and cross-checked pin for pin against [62] (SLVSF66A) Sec. 5 -- the two tables are identical. Pin electrical types follow the table's I/O column: EN/IN1, PH/IN2, nSLEEP, IMODE, PMODE, VREF -> input (EN/IN1, PH/IN2, nSLEEP carry an 'Internal pulldown resistor' per the table; PMODE is tri-level and IMODE quad-level, both latched at nSLEEP wake per Sec. 7.3.2 / 7.4.1, so they are hard-strapped, never driven); nFAULT -> open_collector ('open-drain output ... requires an external pullup', Sec. 5); IPROPI -> output (analog current output proportional to load current, Sec. 7.3.3.1); OUT1/OUT2 -> output (H-bridge outputs); VM, PGND, GND -> power_in; VCP -> passive (charge-pump storage capacitor to VM); CPH/CPL -> passive (charge-pump flying capacitor). Device facts also VERIFIED from [63]: Sec. 6.3 VVM 4.5-37 V, IOUT 0-6 A peak; Sec. 6.5 RDS(on)_HS/LS 100 mOhm typ / 120 max, AIPROPI 450 uA/A, VUVLO 4.35 V typ, IOCP 6 A min / 10 A typ, tRETRY 2 ms, RPD 100 kOhm; Table 7-3 PH/EN truth table (EN=0 -> slow decay/brake, no coast without nSLEEP); Table 7-6 IMODE functions; Table 7-7 fault summary (every fault disables all four FETs = coast); Table 7-1 recommended external components (the same tables are numbered 3 / 6 / 7 / 1 in [62]). FOOTPRINT: TI PWP0016J land pattern from the same datasheet's EXAMPLE BOARD LAYOUT sheet, generated by symbols/tools/gen_ti_powerpad_footprints.py (see its docstring for the dimension-by-dimension trace). The exposed thermal pad is intentionally NOT a symbol pin (repo convention) and is emitted unnumbered in the footprint; tie it to GND/PGND copper at layout ([63] Sec. 5, thermal pad row).
